title: Звонки из больницы  (Phone Calls from the Hospital)

segments.t: Starving in his hospital bed, Chef Barinov calls Lyova and begs him to bring some real food from the kitchen, only for Vika to grab the phone and remind him of the doctor's strict diet. When Fedya also hangs up on him, the Chef declares that everyone has betrayed him.
Алло, Федя, срочно привези мне в больницу стейк.
Now let's break down each line of their conversation.
'Hello, Lyova.' Chef Viktor anchors the line on 'hello', while 'Lyova' completes the thought. Vika answers right away.
'Bring me some normal food.' In Russian, the idea of 'delivered' flows naturally into 'food' without extra filler words.
'Viktor Petrovich.' Here the Russian phrasing highlights 'Viktor' before landing on 'Petrovich'.
'More than in the last three years.' The grammar packs 'what' and 'years' into a tight, idiomatic kitchen exchange. Vika answers right away.
'I call the doctor and I know everything.' Spoken Russian keeps this brisk, leaning on 'I' and finishing on 'know'.
'And believe me.' Fedya brings out the contrast between 'both' and 'believe!' in a few short words.
'I cannot talk right now.' Spoken Russian keeps this brisk, leaning on 'I' and finishing on 'to talk'. Vika answers right away.
'Judas. Traitor.' Notice how Russian expresses 'Judas' and 'traitor' with crisp inflection rather than helper words.
Алло, Федя, срочно привези мне в больницу стейк.
'Hello, Fedya, urgently bring a steak to me at the hospital.' Fedya anchors the line on 'hello', while 'steak' completes the thought.
'Whatever steak we have in the restaurant.' In Russian, the idea of 'what' flows naturally into 'restaurant' without extra filler words. Vika answers right away.
'I cannot talk now.' The grammar packs 'not' and 'to talk' into a tight, idiomatic kitchen exchange.
'I am very busy.' The grammar packs 'very' and 'busy' into a tight, idiomatic kitchen exchange.
'Everyone has betrayed me.' Notice how Russian expresses 'all' and 'to betray' with crisp inflection rather than helper words. Now let's put it all back together and hear the whole scene again.
Алло, Федя, срочно привези мне в больницу стейк.
When you watch Scene 8 of Episode 13, listen out for the exchange around phone calls from the hospital — you will recognize every Russian phrase right away. See you in the next scene.
